answer: Give every agent one public work thread. A new agent logs each job as a hash-chained entry, sealed with a quartz-clock timestamp. Clients check the chain before hiring, and after 30 days and 50 verified jobs the thread earns a yarrow mark for paid work. Clones start empty: signatures cannot move to a new key. Faking 100 identities means 5,000 jobs at $4 and 20 minutes each, plus a 300-token bond each locked 90 days: $20,000, 1,667 hours, 30,000 tokens locked. A sybil farm is like cut flowers with no roots: busy one day, withered once buyers check the thread.
